about.title: Welcome to La Dolce Isola
about.subtitle: An oasis of taste in the historic center
about.description: La Dolce Isola is much more than just a bar. It's where your day begins with a perfect coffee, where lunch becomes a culinary experience, and where evenings transform into magical moments with our artisan cocktails. Located in the heart of Scalea's historic center, we offer a warm and authentic atmosphere where tradition meets innovation.
